sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: On `tag-value-entity`/`tag-value`/`user-tag-value-entity`/`user-tag-value` pages (e.g. `/tag/rock/recording`), the "MB-Name", "Comment", and "Primary alias" columns rendered empty, with the recording's own name and disambiguation comment instead appearing as unlabeled trailing cells (see debug/tag-rock-recording-final.html). Root cause: `cleanupHeaders()` gated its `_resolvedPrimaryCols` set (which decides whether a `syntheticColumnExtractors` entry sourced from 'MB-Name'/'Comment'/'Primary alias', e.g. the `eventParts` extractor's nine `Event-*` columns, gets a header at all) on a plain truthy check of `features.extractMainColumn` — but these four pageTypes declare it as the numeric index `0` (their single native column is always first), which is falsy even though genuinely active. A second, correct check 30-odd lines below the same function already used strict `!== undefined && !== null` and DID inject the MB-Name/Comment/Primary-alias headers themselves — so the header row ended up 9 columns short of the row's actual cell count, and the browser's positional header/cell alignment shifted every column from "Artist" onward. Fixed by hoisting that one strict check to the top of the function and reusing it for both gates, so a single source of truth answers "is extractMainColumn active" consistently.
